title: Number of codec ports
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean symbols, the number of codec ports is $3k+7$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
